title: Family Outdoor Portrait, 1930s Sepia Snapshot, USA
description: A 1930s multi-generational family snapshot showing two boys alongside two women, likely their mother and grandmother, standing outside against a stucco wall. The family is dressed in typical Great Depression-era attire, featuring polka dot and floral pattern dresses, pearl necklaces, high-waisted trousers, and round eyeglasses. A wooden planter box with flowers stands beside them, and the photograph is enclosed within an Art Deco decorative border.
